comments.content: The example points users to the old beta.openai.com API-key page, while the project README uses platform.openai.com/account/api-keys for the same setup flow. This stale setup URL can send users to outdated documentation when configuring the required key.
comments.suggestion_code: # Configure with your account's secret key which can be found at https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys
comments.existing_code: # Configure with your account's secret key which can be found at https://beta.openai.com/account/api-keys
comments.thinking: README.md line 168 documents the platform.openai.com API-key URL, so .env.example should not advertise the older beta.openai.com location.
